device.description: 14-bit 1 MSPS dual simultaneous-sampling SAR ADC, 2x2 fully- or 4x2 pseudo-differential inputs, serial interface with RD/CONVST and internal reference DACs
device.note: ads7223.pdf (SBAS523D, ADS8363/ADS7263/ADS7223) p.4-5 pin functions, p.6 recommended operating conditions, p.11-12 switching characteristics and Figure 1 half-clock timing, p.22-23 operating modes (Table 5 M0/M1), p.25 reset, p.26 output format (Table 7, twos complement), p.27-33 modes I-IV, p.33 reference DAC access, p.34-41 register map

registers.name: CONFIG
registers.note: p.35-36 Figure 39 (default 0000h); written through SDI with every RD frame, no address

registers.name: XFER
registers.note: internal state (not a datasheet register): TGT = the register a CONFIG write-select (A[3:0] = x010 REFDAC1, x101 REFDAC2, 1001 SEQFIFO, 1100 REFCM) makes the next RD frame's SDI word write (1-4, 0 none); RDB = 1 during the read-back frame after a read select, whose SDI data are ignored (p.33, p.34 Table 8, Figure 38)

commands.in: [REFDAC1]
commands.note: p.34 Table 8, Figure 38; p.33: the first five bits are ignored, then RPD and the 10-bit DAC value

commands.name: REFDAC2 data word (frame after the write select)

commands.note: p.34 Table 8, Figure 38; p.33: the first five bits are ignored, then RPD and the 10-bit DAC value

commands.name: REFCM data word (frame after the write select)

commands.name: Register read-back frame (SDI ignored)
commands.note: p.33, p.34 Figure 38: SDI is ignored while a register read access is ongoing

commands.name: Software reset (A = 0100)
commands.in: a b 01 pp f s k e i n 0100
commands.note: p.25: an RD pulse with a control word holding A[3:0] = 0100 resets the device and all registers

commands.note: p.33-34: A[3:0] selects a read; the next RD frame shows the register on SDOA (channel indicator, '0', 16-bit content, '00')

commands.note: p.33-34: A[3:0] selects a read; the next RD frame shows the register on SDOA (channel indicator, '0', 16-bit content, '00')

commands.name: Channel update (R = 00)

pages: p.4 (device comparison, pinout), p.4-5 (pin functions: DVDD 2.3-5.5 V), p.6 (abs max: digital inputs to DVDD + 0.3 V; ROC nominal only), p.11 (tCONV 17.5 tCLK half-clock, fCLK 0.5-20 MHz, tD3 14 ns, tD5 16 ns, tD6 6 ns at 2.3-3.6 V), p.12 (Figure 1), p.22-23 (Tables 4-5, half/full clock), p.24-25 (power-down, reset), p.26 (Table 7 twos complement), p.27-33 (modes I-IV, output bit order), p.33 (Figure 37 REFDAC access), p.34 (Table 8, Figure 38), p.35-36 (CONFIG), p.37 (REFDAC1/2), p.38-40 (SEQFIFO), p.41 (REFCM)
notModeled: analog inputs, the 2x2 fully-differential / 4x2 pseudo-differential multiplexer (PDE), CMA/CMB and the reference DACs on REFIO1/REFIO2: every conversion returns the 0 V (differential) code 0000h; REFIO1/REFIO2 are never driven

the serial frame is delimited by RD (the model's chip select: a frame starts at RD falling, where the first SDOA bit appears, and SDI is sampled on CLOCK falling edges); the CS pin's gating of SDOx/SDI/RD (Hi-Z while CS is high) is not modeled, so keep CS low; SDOA floats during the one-clock RD high pulse in the model

SDOB (converter B in modes I and III) is never driven; SDOA always shifts converter A's frame then converter B's frame (40 clocks: channel indicator, ADC indicator 0/1, result, trailing zeros), which is the mode II / IV SDOA-only order (M1 = 1) and whose first 20 bits are the mode I / III SDOA frame (M1 = 0); mode II's leading '0' instead of the channel indicator is not modeled

CID = 1 (no channel/ADC indicator bits), the 2-bit counter (CE), special read modes (SR), FIFO (FE, SEQFIFO.FD) and the pseudo-differential sequencer (SEQFIFO) do not change the output; M0/M1 strap pins are not read (automatic channel selection and the M0 = 1 'no action' of R = 00/11 are not modeled)

pipeline: SDOA shows the result of the previous conversion in hardware (data n-1); the model's result is the constant 0 V code, so the pipeline is not visible; the channel indicator is CONFIG.C1 at conversion start, without the one-conversion channel-latch delay (channel latched at the 2nd CLOCK falling edge)

conversion time is 17.5 CLOCK periods at the 20 MHz half-clock maximum (875 ns); the real conversion runs on the external CLOCK (17.5 tCLK half-clock, 35 tCLK full-clock mode, FC), and CONVST pulses ignored in mode II / during a running conversion are not modeled
power-down, sleep and auto-sleep modes (PD) and their wake-up times
variants: ADS8363 (16-bit) and ADS7223 (12-bit) share ads7223.pdf with the same pinout, registers and protocol; the lower-resolution parts put their result MSB-aligned with 2 or 4 trailing zeros; own spec files
